c68166a4d4f3ad7f.title: Ribosome remodeling drives translation adaptation during viral infection and cellular stress.
digest: The ribosome is the highly conserved molecular machine that decodes mRNAs during protein synthesis.
Here, we discover that, while traditionally thought to consist of a uniform set of proteins, ribosome composition is reprogrammed to adapt to intrinsic and external cellular perturbations.

evidence.quote: During infection of human cells by non-segmented negative-sense viruses, viral entry into cells recruits the large ribosomal subunit protein rpL40 to a non-canonical site on the small subunit of 80S ribosomes near the mRNA entry site.

b223ced70f56f045.title: Order Matters: Ambient RNA correction confounds doublet detection in single-cell RNA sequencing
digest: A common technical artifact in droplet-based single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) is the capture of two cells in the same droplet, termed doublets.
Doublets may present as hybrid cell types, and their removal is a critical step during quality control.
Another form of contamination is ambient RNA, which originates from free floating RNA released from other cells in suspension, likely during cell death.

digest: Tau phosphorylation is classically associated with neurodegeneration, yet similar phosphorylation patterns emerge during physiological states and acute stress responses.
How these overlapping patterns of phosphorylated Tau (pTau) relate to neuronal adaptation and Alzheimer's disease pathology remains unresolved.
We synthesize findings from human to rodent and fly brains and from neuronal cell models, across neurodevelopment, sleep, hibernation, cellular stress, and disease.

2cb09f9026ee0816.title: Epigenetic aging and transposon dysregulation reflect size-related lifespan compression in dogs.
digest: The extraordinary lifespan variation in domestic dogs provides a natural experiment for testing how intrinsic rates of biological aging shape lifespan.
Using 1640 methylomes from 894 dogs, we developed an epigenetic clock that predicted mortality and demonstrated that epigenetic aging is fastest early in life.
We found that larger and male dogs, which are shorter lived, exhibit accelerated molecular aging.

91eeb318320448ce.title: Firing Without Wiring: How REM-like Sleep Reactivation Rebalances Excitation and Inhibition to Orthogonalize Memories
digest: The role of Rapid Eye Movement (REM) sleep in memory consolidation remains poorly understood.

Several influential ideas propose that REM sleep serves to eliminate crosstalk between memories, thereby orthogonalizing representations of similar ones; however, mechanistic confirmation remains sparse.
We found that REM-like sleep reduces memory interference by decorrelating task-specific neuronal populations, isolating individual memory traces.

evidence.quote: The mechanism held under Dale's law, and depression of excitatory synapses alone, without any inhibitory plasticity, was sufficient.

digest: Higher-order chromatin structure is linked to cell differentiation and aging, but its native distribution in tissues and role in organismal development remain unclear.

Compared with high-throughput chromosome conformation Capture (Hi-C), SpaceA captures substantially more contacts over distances beyond 10 Mb, thereby enhancing detection of higher-order chromatin dynamics.

digest: A transcriptomic clock trained on 27 {degrees}C mosquitoes (error {+/-}0.9 days) read 32 {degrees}C mosquitoes as 2.4 days older (95% CI 1.9-2.9) and 30 {degrees}C mosquitoes as 1.1 days older.
The gap opened by day 5 and then stopped growing: between days 5 and 15, warmth added 0.01 extra days per day (95% CI -0.16 to 0.19), well below the 0.29-0.45 expected if the clock ran faster.

68e862ade78e77cd.title: Fierce Pharma Asia—Roche’s $1.2B obesity deal; Asahi Kasei’s FDA nod; Verastem’s KRAS boon
digest: Roche extended its China shopping spree with a $1 billion-plus obesity deal. Asahi Kasei's Hovilpri became the first HSV drug with a novel mechanism approved in nearly 30 years. Verastem's China-licensed KRAS G12D inhibitor showed strong early data in pancreatic cancer. And more.

51fc50509b0d33b5.title: NNMT enhances hyperandrogenism in polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome through epigenetic remodelling
digest: Nicotinamide N-methyltransferase promotes and sustains hyperandrogenism in polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome through metabolic and epigenetic reprogramming.
